items.explanation: A campaign that targets no audience: money spent on nobody. Give it `audiences`.
items.title: Campaign targets no audience

items.explanation: A message that cites no brand rule: copy that skipped the brand check. Name the rules it `obeys`.
items.title: Message cites no brand rule

items.explanation: A campaign that ends before it starts: a calendar typo. Set `ends` on or after `starts`.
items.title: Campaign ends before it starts

items.explanation: A brand rule no message obeys: a rule nobody checks against. Cite it from a message, or remove it.
items.title: Brand rule obeyed by no message
